step1_analysis.description: A fully differential two-stage op-amp consisting of a telescopic cascode first stage and a common-source second stage. It includes common-mode feedback (CMFB) control nodes (VCF1, VCF2) for both stages to stabilize the output common-mode voltages.

paper_reference.title: A 15-b 40-MS/s CMOS Pipelined Analog-to-Digital Converter With Digital Background Calibration

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm1*Ro1 * gm9*Ro2. With W=5u, L=0.5u, Id~43uA, gm~477uS, Ro1~12MOhm, Ro2~116kOhm.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The telescopic first stage provides high gain (~75dB), and the second stage provides moderate gain (~30dB).

sky130_expected.calculation: GBW = gm1 / (2*pi*CL). gm1~477uS, CL=4pF. GBW = 477u / (2*pi*4p) = 19 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The provided netlist uses small parameterized W/L (5u/0.5u) compared to the paper's likely much larger devices, resulting in lower gm and GBW.

Phase_Margin.description: Phase margin at unity gain frequency

sky130_expected.calculation: Depends on compensation capacitor CC. With CC=1pF and CL=4pF, PM should be around 60 degrees.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard target for stable op-amp operation in closed-loop configurations.
Power is much lower than the paper because the parameterized W/L in the netlist are small, drawing less current.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure open-loop gain, GBW, phase margin, and power consumption of the fully differential op-amp. Ideal CMFB is used to set the DC operating points.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Fully Differential Two-Stage Op-Amp
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm15=5u L_xm15=0.5u
.param W_xm16=5u L_xm16=0.5u

XM11 VOP VB4 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM7 B VB4 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N1 VB4 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM12 VON VB4 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM5 A VB3 B VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N2 VB3 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM3 A VB2 N3 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N2 VB2 N4 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM1 N3 VIP N7 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N4 VIN N7 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM13 N7 VCF1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM14 N7 VCF1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}
XM9 VOP A N5 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 VON N2 N6 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM15 N5 VCF2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm15} w={W_xm15}
XM16 N6 VCF2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm16} w={W_xm16}

* Power Supplies
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVSS VSS 0 0

* Biases
VVB4 VB4 0 0.99
VVB3 VB3 0 0.5
VVB2 VB2 0 1.2

* Ideal CMFB to set operating points
B1 VCF1 0 V='0.6 + 10*(v(A) + v(N2) - 1.2)'
B2 VCF2 0 V='1.8 + 10*(v(VOP) + v(VON) - 1.8)'

* Inputs (DC for OP/AC, Pulse for Tran)
VVIP VIP 0 DC 0.9 AC 0.5 PULSE(0.8 1.0 10n 1n 1n 40n 100n)
VVIN VIN 0 DC 0.9 AC -0.5 PULSE(1.0 0.8 10n 1n 1n 40n 100n)

* Loads and Compensation
CL1 VOP 0 4p
CL2 VON 0 4p
CC1 A VOP 1p
CC2 N2 VON 1p

.control
* DC Operating Point & Power
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power
print v(VOP) v(VON) v(A) v(N2) v(VCF1) v(VCF2)

* AC Analysis
ac dec 100 1 10G
let vout_diff = v(VOP) - v(VON)
let gain_db = 20*log10(mag(vout_diff))
let phase = 180/PI * cph(vout_diff)
let pm = 180 + phase

meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10
meas ac gbw when gain_db=0 fall=1
meas ac phase_margin find pm when gain_db=0 fall=1

* Transient Analysis
tran 0.1n 100n
let vout_diff_tran = v(VOP) - v(VON)
meas tran t_rise trig vout_diff_tran val=-1.0 rise=1 targ vout_diff_tran val=1.0 rise=1
.endc
.end
